voci.riassunto: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO days after admitting to an affair following scrutiny of his relationship with a woman reportedly deemed a Chinese spy.

voci.riassunto: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.4% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

voci.titolo: Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’
voci.riassunto: The tech giant's web of ties to other companies is raising the possibility that it could do far-reaching economic and financial damage.

voci.titolo: UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'
voci.riassunto: The U.K. economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter of the year, in line with estimates.

voci.titolo: Consumers are showing signs of strain even as they keep spending, CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor shows
voci.riassunto: Retail sales rose at their slowest pace in nearly a year in October as American consumers showed signs of strain from high prices.

voci.titolo: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
voci.riassunto: The report comes at a critical juncture for the Federal Reserve as it considers its next move regarding interest rates.

voci.titolo: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
voci.riassunto: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion as of October, potentially intensifying complaints from trading partners already wary over the glut of cheap Chinese goods.

voci.titolo: 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong

voci.titolo: A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect

voci.titolo: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
voci.riassunto: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.

voci.titolo: A disturbing employment trend is hiding beneath the latest strong job numbers
voci.riassunto: The average jobless worker's bout of unemployment surpassed 27 weeks in October, the highest outside of the pandemic period in a decade.

voci.titolo: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
voci.riassunto: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate was expected to hold steady at 4.2%.

voci.riassunto: Participants in the CNBC Voter Poll ranked the economy the most important issue facing the country, ahead of topics tied to democracy and immigration.
